title: Yara and the Lantern
author: Kestrel Blackwood
blurb: Ulyana Marchetti, a mapmaker's apprentice finishing the atlas the master died for, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. Then the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must choose which family member gets the last berth before the century turns.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
